```yaml
name: Check dist changes

on:
  pull_request:
    # Trigger on any PR that targets any branch
    branches: [main, master, develop]

jobs:
  check-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fail if dist/ modified
        run: |
          # Get the list of files changed in this PR
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }})
          echo "Changed files:"
          echo "$CHANGED_FILES"

          # Check for any changes under dist/
          if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -q '^dist/'; then
            echo "::error::dist/ changes detected. Please do not modify dist directly."
            exit 1
          fi
```
